reply.text:
That's one for a doctor or physio, not a coach—I can't assess what's going on with your knees from here. Get it checked if it's new or gets worse.

Once you know what you're working with, tell me what to avoid and I'll build around it. What did you train yesterday? No workout logged yesterday, so I can't see what you did. If the soreness is just normal delayed-onset soreness from a hard session, that usually settles in a couple of days and you can train through it. But if it's sharp, swelling, or doesn't feel right, that's the doctor call first.
